record.question: As per the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945, which document must a community pharmacy maintain when ordering medicines from a licensed wholesaler?
options: A delivery note certified by a drug inspector
Records of invoices showing the wholesaler's license number
A copy of the wholesaler's retail license (form 20)
Approval order signed by a registered medical practitioner (RMP)
record.explanation: Answer B: Records of invoices showing the wholesaler's license number. Drugs and Cosmetics Rules require purchase records/invoices that identify the supplier and the relevant license particulars; the wholesaler’s license number is recorded on the purchase invoice. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/19158/1/2016drugsandcosmeticsact1940rules1945.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
